scripts:
create path (sling:OrderedFolder) /content
create path (sling:Folder) /conf
create service user studio-replication-service
set ACL for studio-replication-service
    allow jcr:read on /
    allow jcr:all on /content
    allow jcr:all on /conf
    allow jcr:all on /etc
    allow jcr:all on /var
end

set ACL for studio-replication-service
    allow jcr:readAccessControl on /home
end

create path (sling:Folder) /etc/replication
create path (sling:Folder) /etc/replication/agents.author
create path (sling:Folder) /var/studio
create path (sling:Folder) /var/studio/replication
create path (sling:Folder) /etc/truststore

create path /etc/replication/agents.author/publish(cq:Page)/jcr:content(cq:PageContent)
set properties on /etc/replication/agents.author/publish/jcr:content
  default sling:resourceType{String} to "cq/replication/components/agent"
  default jcr:title{String} to "Live"
  default jcr:description{String} to "Sends what is published to the live site."
  default enabled{Boolean} to true
  default transportUri{String} to "http://localhost:4503/bin/receive"
  default transportUser{String} to "studio-transport"
  default transportPassword{String} to "dev-WhxFuxTcdwK_htCtFK55K29a"
  default retryDelay{Long} to 60000
  default serializationType{String} to "studio"
end

create path /etc/replication/agents.author/publish_reverse(cq:Page)/jcr:content(cq:PageContent)
set properties on /etc/replication/agents.author/publish_reverse/jcr:content
  default sling:resourceType{String} to "cq/replication/components/agent"
  default jcr:title{String} to "From Live"
  default jcr:description{String} to "Fetches what visitors created on the live site (form submissions, user-generated content) from its outbox."
  default enabled{Boolean} to true
  default transportUri{String} to "http://localhost:4503/bin/outbox"
  default transportUser{String} to "studio-transport"
  default transportPassword{String} to "dev-WhxFuxTcdwK_htCtFK55K29a"
  default retryDelay{Long} to 60000
  default serializationType{String} to "reverse"
end
